instrument.evidence: The extracted peptides were dried in a speed-vac and then resuspended in 2% (v/v) ACN, 0.1% (v/v) FA, and analyzed on an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer, coupled to a Dionex U3000 nanoHPLC system (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

The resulting peptides were then dried, dissolved in 5% ACN/0.1% FA (both v/v), and measured on a hybrid quadruple-Obitrap Exploris480 mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) coupled to an Ultimate 3000 UHPLC system (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
